Subject: Initial SIG request for Redwood — please assign owners

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement security review I’m attaching our SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) worksheet — v1.1 — for Redwood to complete. We’re aiming to finish intake by EOD Aug 6 so procurement can move to contract review next week.

Key asks:
- Please identify an owner for each SIG section and provide an estimated evidence delivery date.
- If a section is not applicable, mark N/A and add a one-line justification.
- Attach any existing artifacts (SOC 2 report, config screenshots, or policy docs) and reference them in the evidence index.

Files attached: FinWave_SIG_v1.1.xlsx (master questionnaire), evidence-index-template.csv

Let me know if you want to schedule a 30-min walkthrough; otherwise we’ll accept the completed worksheet and artifacts via email or a secure upload link.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
